versions.subject: refactor: chisel rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\chisel.exe'
selection_param1:
    CommandLine|contains: 
        - 'exe client '
        - 'exe server '
selection_param2:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' --socks5'
        - ' --reverse'
        - ' r:'
        - ':127.0.0.1:'
        - ' --tls-skip-verify '
        - ':socks'
condition: selection_img or all of selection_param*
versions.spl: Image="*\\chisel.exe" OR (CommandLine IN ("*exe client *", "*exe server *") CommandLine IN ("* --socks5*", "* --reverse*", "* r:*", "*:127.0.0.1:*", "* --tls-skip-verify *", "*:socks*"))
